segments.an8.50:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti.
segments.an8.50:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
segments.an8.50:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo ye te bhattu abbhantarā kammantā … pe …
segments.an8.50:2.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakammanto hoti.
segments.an8.50:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo yo so bhattu abbhantaro antojano … pe …
segments.an8.50:3.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo saṅgahitaparijano hoti.
segments.an8.50:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattu amanāpasaṅkhātaṃ taṃ jīvitahetupi na ajjhācarati.
segments.an8.50:4.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo bhattu manāpaṃ carati.
segments.an8.50:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati … pe …
segments.an8.50:5.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
segments.an8.50:5.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, ayaṃsa loko āraddho hoti.
segments.an8.50:6.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraloko āraddho hoti.
segments.an8.50:6.3: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
segments.an8.50:7.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo saddho hoti … pe …
segments.an8.50:7.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti.
segments.an8.50:8.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe …
segments.an8.50:8.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo sīlasampanno hoti.
segments.an8.50:9.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati … pe …
segments.an8.50:9.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo cāgasampanno hoti.
segments.an8.50:10.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo paññavā hoti … pe …
segments.an8.50:10.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo paññāsampanno hoti.
segments.an8.50:10.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo paralokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, paraloko āraddho hotī”ti.

lines: 49-50. Navame ayaṃ’ sa loko āraddho hotīti ayamassa loko idhaloke karaṇamattāya āraddhattā paripuṇṇattā āraddho hoti paripuṇṇo.
Soḷasākārasampannāti sutte vuttehi aṭṭhahi, gāthāsu aṭṭhahīti soḷasahi ākārehi samannāgatā, yāni vā aṭṭhaṅgāni parampi tesu samādapetīti evampi soḷasākārasampannāti eke.
Sabbasuttesu pana yaṃ na vuttaṃ, taṃ heṭṭhā āgatanayattā uttānatthamevāti.
Yo hi diṭṭhadhammikaṃ anatthaṃ parivajjanavasena abhibhavati, tato eva tadatthaṃ sampādeti, so idhalokavijayāya paṭipanno nāma hoti paccatthikaniggaṇhanato sadatthasampādanato ca.

Tenāha “ayaṃsa loko āraddho hotī”ti.(Pasaṃsāvahato tayidaṃ pasaṃsāvahanaṃ kittisaddena idhaloke saddānaṃ cittatosanaviddheyyabhāvāpādanena ca hotīti daṭṭhabbaṃ.) Susaṃvihitakammantoti yāgubhattapacanakālādīni anatikkamitvā tassa tassa sādhukaṃ karaṇena suṭṭhu saṃvihitakammanto.
Yo hi samparāyikaṃ anatthaṃ parivajjanavasena abhibhavati, tato eva tadatthaṃ sampādeti, so paralokavijayāya paṭipanno nāma hoti.
